title: Esports' Biggest Prize Ever Just Collapsed
hook: It was $40 million. Then Valve changed one thing.
source: Prize pool totals for Dota 2's The International, per Valve's own compendium/battle-pass disclosures and reporting by Tips.GG, GosuGamers and esports outlets: TI5 (2015) $18.4M, TI8 (2018) approx. $25.5M, TI9 (2019) approx. $34.3M, TI10 (2021) $40.0M (an all-time esports record), TI11 (2022) $18.9M, TI12 (2023) $3.0M, TI13 (2024) $2.8M — the crash followed Valve ending the crowdfunded Battle Pass/Compendium model in 2023. League of Legends World Championship prize pools (Riot Games, via Statista/Fragster): 2015 approx. $2.13M, 2018 $6.45M (its own record year), 2019-2024 stable around $2.2-2.3M each year, including just under $2.23M in 2024.
